item: Restore staging is a private 0700 folder with owner-only files, and the sweep removes only a real folder of ours (R829 B)
summary: Every restore and import group stages in a fresh mkdtemp folder (0700); members, the plaintext export of an encrypted corpus, an uploaded bare database and extracted zip members are created 0600 through create_new. The boot sweep removes a .restore-* entry only when it is a real folder (lstat, no reparse point) owned by the app's user, removes it by descriptor (rmtree's symlink-safe walk) and dates entries without following links. R829 (A), keyed staging, follows after its proof run.
